headline: Executive order changes the National Quantum Initiative Advisory Committee, a group that advises the federal government on quantum science.
what_it_does: This order makes changes to the National Quantum Initiative Advisory Committee, which gives the federal government outside advice on quantum information science and technology. The title says the order is meant to strengthen or expand the committee's role. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the National Quantum Initiative Advisory Committee
who_it_affects.how: The order changes the committee they serve on, though the exact details are not given in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: 2022-05-04 (date signed; no separate effective date provided)
